patterns.title: Zigzag Basket
patterns.description: The complete 89-row weft-color sequence, with each numbered row expanded into the three krokbragd picks and its printed repeats. Threading represents the 60 doubled warp ends; basket shaping and tripled floating selvedges are worked separately.

patterns.title: Plaid About You Throw
patterns.description: Full 608-end multicolor plaid threading and six complete passes of the printed two-column weft repeat. Inner stripe repeats are expanded; floating selvedges and fringe are separate from the draft.

patterns.title: Shadow Play Dish Towels — Towel 1 — X
patterns.description: Full 442-end threading and warp color order. Numeric treadling brackets and the motif color order are expanded; inch-length hems retain the displayed starter and ending picks. Towel 3 shows ten repeats of its continuous motif.

patterns.title: Shadow Play Dish Towels — Towel 4 — X and O
patterns.description: The printed mixed X-and-O treadling sequence and matching accent colors on the shared 442-end shadow-weave warp. Inch-length hems are represented by their displayed picks.

patterns.title: Autumn Berries Cushion Cover
patterns.description: The 477-end point threading and skeleton tie-up, including simultaneous treadles. All 36 accent-color repeats are represented. This is the flat loom draft; fulling produces the cushion’s sculptural doubleweave texture.

patterns.title: Stormy Skies Towels — Slate
patterns.description: Full 415-end huck warp with this solid cotton weft and a contrasting plaid band. The band uses the project’s example sequence from the start of the warp color order; its placement follows the 20-inch starting section. The 35-inch towel and ten-pick hems are expanded at the specified 16 picks per inch. The article invites changes to the plaid bands.

patterns.title: Stormy Skies Towels — Plaid
patterns.description: The fifth towel follows the entire warp color order as weft, expanding the central 3x color bracket to 12x as instructed. The complete plaid sequence is framed by twenty plain-weave picks at each end.

patterns.title: Stormy Skies Wrap
patterns.description: The same complete 415-end cotton warp with Quarry-colored silk weft. The 84-inch patterned length is expanded at 16 picks per inch, with four plain-weave picks at each end; hemstitching and fringe are separate.

patterns.title: Prairie School Rug
patterns.description: Complete 1,080-end warp color order, alternating shafts 1 and 2. The printed thick-and-thin weft cycle and its numeric brackets are expanded. The three-inch hems remain the displayed thin-pick pair. Relative yarn thickness distinguishes the tripled heavy weft from the fine cotton binder.

patterns.title: Turned Twill on Three Blocks — 8-shaft study
patterns.description: The article’s complete comparison tie-up, with the numbered block threadings and treadlings. The source design unit is repeated four times for a readable sample; the first two picks show the plain-weave hem sheds.

patterns.title: Ribbons and Blocks Runner — Runner 1
patterns.description: Complete 430-end threading, with all four-end module repeats expanded. Every numbered block repeat and accent color in the two-column runner chart is encoded as four consecutive picks. The background block uses Royal; the other two blocks form interlacing ribbons. Hem picks and floating selvedges are separate.

patterns.title: Ribbons and Blocks Runner — Runner 2
patterns.description: Complete 430-end threading, with all four-end module repeats expanded. Hem picks and floating selvedges are separate.

patterns.title: Choose a Path Pillows
patterns.description: The full 360-end five-yarn point threading and printed sequence of differently colored reversing-twill bands, including its 3x and 2x brackets. Plain-weave sections are woven to the project’s measured lengths. Bouclé picks are doubled.

patterns.title: Choose a Path — Twill circle
patterns.description: The numbered treadling example from the twill-circle article, repeated four times on the project’s point threading. The studies compare direction changes and starting treadles using the same four twill sheds.

patterns.title: Family Dinner Napkins — Napkin 1
patterns.description: Complete 604-end color-striped threading and this napkin’s eight-row linen weft color order. All numeric 2x and 5x treadling brackets are expanded. Hem and white-frame sections specified in inches retain their printed starter picks; weave those sections to the stated lengths in the project.

patterns.title: Family Dinner — Towel
patterns.description: The towel treadling on the shared 604-end warp. All 2x, 3x, and 8x brackets and nine colored stripes are expanded, with the printed cotton/cottolin color sequence. Inch-length sewing hems and white frames retain their displayed starter picks.

patterns.title: Falling Leaves Runner
patterns.description: Full 247-end autumn-color warp, with the nested 15x and 2x threading brackets expanded. Four complete leaf motifs are shown between the two-pick plain-weave ends. The original runner continues the motif to a measured 75-inch woven length; floating selvedges and Italian hemstitching are separate.
